controls.name: policies for information security
controls.description: Information security policy and topic-specific policies shall be defined, approved by management, published, communicated to and acknowledged by relevant personnel and relevant interested parties, and reviewed at planned intervals and if significant changes occur.

deployment_points.name: Define the information security policy and any topic-specific policies in collaboration with key stakeholders.
Obtain formal approval of the policies from senior management to ensure organizational support.
Publish the approved policies on the organization's intranet and distribute them to all relevant personnel.
Conduct training sessions to communicate the policies and ensure understanding among employees and interested parties.
Schedule regular reviews of the policies at least annually or when significant changes occur to maintain relevance.

controls.name: information security roles and responsibilities
controls.description: Information security roles and responsibilities shall be defined and allocated according to the organization needs.

deployment_points.name: Identify key information security roles required within the organization based on its structure and needs.
Develop clear job descriptions that outline specific responsibilities related to information security for each role.
Assign roles to qualified personnel, ensuring they have the necessary skills and training.
Communicate the defined roles and responsibilities to all employees to promote accountability.
Review and update roles and responsibilities regularly to adapt to changes in the organization or security landscape.

controls.name: management responsibilities
controls.description: Management shall require all personnel to apply information security in accordance with the established information security policy, topic-specific policies and procedures of the organization.

deployment_points.name: Ensure that management actively promotes the importance of adhering to the information security policies among all personnel.
Integrate information security requirements into employee performance evaluations to reinforce compliance.
Provide ongoing training and resources to help personnel understand their responsibilities regarding information security.
Establish a reporting mechanism for non-compliance and ensure that management addresses violations promptly.
Regularly review and update management's approach to enforcing information security compliance based on feedback and incidents.

controls.name: contact with special interest groups
controls.description: The organization shall establish and maintain contact with special interest groups or other specialist security forums and professional associations.

deployment_points.name: Identify relevant special interest groups and professional associations in the field of information security.
Designate personnel responsible for establishing and maintaining contact with these groups.
Attend meetings, webinars, and conferences to stay informed about the latest security trends and best practices.
Share insights and findings from these interactions with the broader organization to enhance security awareness.
Evaluate the effectiveness of these contacts periodically and adjust engagement strategies as necessary.

controls.name: threat intelligence
controls.description: Information relating to information security threats shall be collected and analysed to produce threat intelligence.

deployment_points.name: Establish a process for collecting information on potential information security threats from various sources.
Analyze the collected data to identify patterns, trends, and emerging threats relevant to the organization.
Develop threat intelligence reports that summarize findings and provide actionable recommendations.
Distribute threat intelligence reports to relevant stakeholders to inform decision-making and security posture.
Review and refine the threat intelligence process regularly to ensure it remains effective and relevant.

controls.name: inventory of information and other associated assets
controls.description: An inventory of information and other associated assets, including owners, shall be developed and maintained.

deployment_points.name: Create a comprehensive list of all information assets and associated resources within the organization.
Assign ownership of each asset to specific individuals or teams responsible for its management and security.
Implement a system for regularly updating the inventory to reflect changes in asset status or ownership.
Conduct periodic audits of the inventory to ensure accuracy and completeness.
Utilize the inventory to inform risk assessments and security planning efforts.

controls.name: acceptable use of information and other associated assets
controls.description: Rules for the acceptable use and procedures for handling information and other associated assets shall be identified, documented and implemented.

deployment_points.name: Develop a clear set of acceptable use policies that outline the proper handling of information and associated assets.
Document the procedures for accessing, using, and sharing information assets in accordance with these policies.
Communicate the acceptable use policies to all personnel and provide training on their importance.
Monitor compliance with the acceptable use policies and address violations promptly.
Review and update the acceptable use policies regularly to ensure they remain relevant and effective.

controls.name: return of assets
controls.description: Personnel and other interested parties as appropriate shall return all the organizationΓÇÖs assets in their possession upon change or termination of their employment, contract or agreement.

deployment_points.name: Establish a formal process for the return of organizational assets upon employee termination or contract completion.
Communicate the asset return policy to all personnel during onboarding and at regular intervals.
Create a checklist of assets that must be returned, including electronic devices, documents, and access credentials.
Designate personnel responsible for overseeing the return process and ensuring compliance.
Conduct audits to verify that all assets have been returned and address any discrepancies immediately.

controls.name: classification of information
controls.description: Information shall be classified according to the information security needs of the organization based on confidentiality, integrity, availability and relevant interested party requirements.

deployment_points.name: Develop a classification scheme that categorizes information based on its confidentiality, integrity, and availability requirements.
Train personnel on how to classify information correctly according to the established scheme.
Implement procedures for labeling and handling classified information to ensure appropriate security measures are applied.
Regularly review and update the classification scheme to reflect changes in organizational needs or regulatory requirements.
Monitor compliance with the classification policies and provide feedback to improve adherence.

controls.name: labelling of information
controls.description: An appropriate set of procedures for information labelling shall be developed and implemented in accordance with the information classification scheme adopted by the organization.

deployment_points.name: Create detailed procedures for labeling information based on the established classification scheme.
Ensure that all personnel are trained on the labeling procedures and the importance of accurate labeling.
Implement a system for reviewing and approving labels to maintain consistency and compliance.
Regularly audit labeled information to ensure adherence to the labeling procedures and correct any discrepancies.
Update labeling procedures as necessary to align with changes in the classification scheme or organizational policies.

controls.name: information transfer
controls.description: Information transfer rules, procedures, or agreements shall be in place for all types of transfer facilities within the organization and between the organization and other parties.

deployment_points.name: Develop comprehensive information transfer policies that outline the types of information that can be transferred and the methods of transfer allowed.
Establish procedures for securely transferring information, including encryption and secure channels, to protect data integrity and confidentiality.
Create agreements with external parties that specify the security measures required for information transfer, including compliance with relevant regulations.
Train employees on the information transfer policies and procedures to ensure they understand their responsibilities and the importance of secure information handling.
Regularly review and update information transfer rules and procedures to adapt to new threats and changes in technology.

controls.name: access control
controls.description: Rules to control physical and logical access to information and other associated assets shall be established and implemented based on business and information security requirements.

deployment_points.name: Define access control policies that specify who can access what information and under what circumstances, based on business needs.
Implement physical access controls such as key cards, biometric scanners, or security personnel to restrict access to sensitive areas.
Utilize logical access controls, including user authentication methods like passwords, two-factor authentication, and role-based access controls.
Regularly review and audit access rights to ensure they align with current roles and responsibilities, making adjustments as necessary.
Provide training for employees on access control policies and the importance of safeguarding sensitive information.

controls.name: authentication information
controls.description: Allocation and management of authentication information shall be controlled by a management process, including advising personnel on appropriate handling of authentication information.

deployment_points.name: Establish a formal process for the allocation of authentication information, ensuring that it is unique and securely generated for each user.
Implement guidelines for the secure storage and handling of authentication information, including password complexity and change frequency requirements.
Train personnel on the importance of safeguarding authentication information and recognizing phishing attempts or other security threats.
Regularly review and update authentication information management processes to incorporate best practices and address emerging threats.
Monitor and log access attempts to detect unauthorized use of authentication information and respond accordingly.

controls.name: access rights

deployment_points.name: Develop a clear policy outlining the process for provisioning, reviewing, modifying, and removing access rights based on user roles.
Implement a system for tracking access rights that allows for easy review and modification as roles change within the organization.
Conduct regular audits of access rights to ensure compliance with the access control policy and identify any discrepancies.
Establish a process for promptly removing access rights when an employee leaves the organization or changes roles.
Provide training to managers and employees on the importance of access rights management and the procedures for requesting changes.

controls.name: information security in supplier relationships

deployment_points.name: Identify and assess the information security risks associated with each supplier relationship, considering the sensitivity of the data involved.

Create a communication plan to ensure that suppliers are aware of their responsibilities regarding information security and any changes to requirements.
Document and maintain records of supplier assessments, agreements, and any incidents related to information security for accountability and future reference.

controls.name: addressing information security within supplier agreements
controls.description: Relevant information security requirements shall be established and agreed with each supplier based on the type of supplier relationship.

deployment_points.name: Define specific information security requirements that must be included in supplier agreements based on the nature of the relationship and data sensitivity.
Ensure that all supplier agreements are reviewed by legal and information security teams to confirm compliance with organizational policies.
Establish a process for negotiating and finalizing security requirements with suppliers, ensuring mutual understanding and agreement.
Regularly review and update supplier agreements to reflect changes in security requirements or organizational policies.
Maintain a repository of all supplier agreements and associated security requirements for easy access and auditing purposes.

controls.name: managing information security in the information and communication technology (ict) supply chain
controls.description: Processes and procedures shall be defined and implemented to manage the information security risks associated with the ICT products and services supply chain.

deployment_points.name: Identify and assess the information security risks associated with each component of the ICT supply chain, including hardware and software.
Develop a risk management framework specifically for ICT supply chain security that outlines roles, responsibilities, and procedures.
Implement monitoring processes to continuously evaluate the security posture of ICT suppliers and their products or services.
Establish incident response procedures for addressing security breaches or vulnerabilities identified within the ICT supply chain.
Provide training for relevant personnel on ICT supply chain security risks and best practices for managing those risks.

controls.name: monitoring, review and change management of supplier services
controls.description: The organization shall regularly monitor, review, evaluate and manage change in supplier information security practices and service delivery.

deployment_points.name: Establish a monitoring framework to regularly assess supplier performance and compliance with information security requirements.
Schedule periodic reviews of supplier services to evaluate their effectiveness and identify areas for improvement.
Implement a change management process that requires suppliers to notify the organization of any changes to their information security practices.
Document all monitoring and review activities, including findings and actions taken, to ensure accountability and transparency.
Provide feedback to suppliers based on monitoring results and collaborate on improvements to enhance information security.

controls.name: information security for use of cloud services

controls.name: information security incident management planning and preparation

deployment_points.name: Develop an incident management policy that outlines the processes for identifying, reporting, and responding to information security incidents.
Establish a dedicated incident response team with clearly defined roles and responsibilities for managing incidents.
Create incident response procedures that include steps for containment, eradication, recovery, and communication during an incident.
Conduct regular training and simulation exercises for the incident response team to ensure preparedness and effective response.
Implement a post-incident review process to analyze incidents, identify lessons learned, and improve future incident management practices.

controls.name: assessment and decision on information security events
controls.description: The organization shall assess information security events and decide if they are to be categorized as information security incidents.

deployment_points.name: Establish a dedicated team responsible for assessing information security events and categorizing them as incidents or non-incidents.
Develop a standardized assessment framework that outlines criteria for categorizing events, including severity, impact, and likelihood.
Implement a reporting mechanism for information security events to ensure timely and accurate data collection.
Conduct regular training sessions for staff on how to identify and report information security events effectively.
Review and update the assessment process periodically to incorporate lessons learned and adapt to evolving threats.

controls.name: learning from information security incidents
controls.description: Knowledge gained from information security incidents shall be used to strengthen and improve the information security controls.

Integrate lessons learned into training programs to enhance the overall security posture of the organization.

controls.name: collection of evidence

deployment_points.name: Develop a formalized procedure for the identification and collection of evidence during information security events.
Train staff on the importance of evidence preservation and the correct methods for collecting evidence.
Ensure that all evidence is collected in a manner that maintains its integrity and is admissible in legal proceedings.

Regularly review and update evidence collection procedures to align with best practices and legal requirements.

controls.name: information security during disruption

controls.name: ict readiness for business continuity

Maintain documentation of all ICT systems and their dependencies to facilitate recovery efforts.
Provide training for ICT staff on business continuity procedures and their roles in maintaining ICT readiness.

controls.name: legal, statutory, regulatory and contractual requirements

Provide training to relevant staff on compliance obligations and the importance of adhering to legal and regulatory standards.

controls.name: protection of records

Train employees on the importance of PII protection and the specific measures in place to safeguard personal data.

controls.name: independent review of information security

deployment_points.name: Establish a schedule for independent reviews of the information security management system at regular intervals.

controls.name: compliance with policies, rules and standards for information security

Provide training to employees on the importance of compliance and the specific policies they must follow.
Regularly update policies and standards to reflect changes in regulations, best practices, and organizational needs.

controls.name: documented operating procedures

deployment_points.name: Identify all critical processes within the information processing facilities that require documented procedures.
Develop detailed operating procedures that outline each process step, including roles and responsibilities.
Ensure that the documented procedures are reviewed and approved by relevant stakeholders to maintain accuracy and compliance.
Distribute the documented procedures to all personnel who require access, ensuring they understand how to use them effectively.
Establish a regular review cycle to update the procedures as necessary, reflecting any changes in processes or regulations.

controls.name: segregation of duties

deployment_points.name: Conduct a risk assessment to identify areas where conflicting duties may exist within the organization.
Define clear roles and responsibilities for each position to ensure that no individual has control over all aspects of any critical process.

controls.name: contact with authorities

Regularly review and update the contact list and communication protocols to ensure they remain current and effective.

controls.name: information security in project management
controls.description: Information security shall be integrated into project management.

deployment_points.name: Develop a framework for integrating information security considerations into all phases of project management, from initiation to closure.
Identify security requirements for each project and ensure they are documented in project plans.
Train project managers and team members on the importance of information security and how to implement security measures effectively.
Conduct regular security assessments throughout the project lifecycle to identify and mitigate risks.
Review and update project management methodologies to include best practices for information security.

controls.name: identity management

Provide training to employees on identity management practices and the importance of safeguarding their credentials.
Establish a process for promptly revoking access when an employee leaves the organization or changes roles.

controls.name: response to information security incidents

deployment_points.name: Develop and document an incident response plan that outlines the steps to be taken in the event of an information security incident.
Train all relevant personnel on the incident response procedures to ensure they understand their roles and responsibilities.
Establish a communication plan for reporting incidents internally and externally, including to relevant authorities if necessary.

Review and update the incident response plan regularly to incorporate lessons learned from past incidents and changes in the threat landscape.

controls.name: intellectual property rights

Establish a process for reporting and addressing any potential infringements or violations of intellectual property rights.

controls.name: screening

controls.name: responsibilities after termination or change of employment

controls.name: supporting utilities
controls.description: Information processing facilities shall be protected from power failures and other disruptions caused by failures in supporting utilities.

deployment_points.name: Identify critical utilities that support information processing facilities and assess their reliability.
Implement backup systems, such as uninterruptible power supplies (UPS) and generators, to ensure continuous operation during outages.
Regularly test backup systems to ensure they function correctly during power failures or disruptions.
Develop contingency plans for utility failures, including procedures for data protection and recovery.
Train staff on the importance of utility management and emergency procedures related to power failures.

controls.name: cabling security
security measures for working in secure areas shall be designed and implemented
controls.description: Define and document processes and requirements to address the control: Security measures for working in secure areas shall be designed and implemented. Assign appropriate responsibilities and implement the required measures for working in secure areas. Establish and maintain records or evidence demonstrating compliance with working in secure areas. Regularly review and monitor the implementation of working in secure areas and address identified gaps. Provide appropriate awareness, guidance, or training to relevant personnel for working in secure areas.

deployment_points.name: Define security protocols for personnel working in secure areas, including access controls and behavior expectations.
Implement physical security measures, such as security personnel and surveillance, to monitor secure areas.
Maintain documentation of security measures and compliance records for audits and reviews.
Conduct regular training sessions for personnel on secure area protocols and emergency procedures.
Regularly review and update security measures to address any identified vulnerabilities or changes in operations.

controls.description: Cables carrying power, data or supporting information services shall be protected from interception, interference or damage.

deployment_points.name: Identify and map all cabling routes to ensure visibility and facilitate security measures.
Use protective conduits or enclosures for cables to prevent physical damage and unauthorized access.
Implement monitoring systems to detect tampering or interference with cabling infrastructure.
Regularly inspect cabling for signs of wear, damage, or unauthorized modifications.
Train personnel on the importance of cabling security and procedures for reporting issues.

controls.name: equipment maintenance
controls.description: Equipment shall be maintained correctly to ensure availability, integrity and confidentiality of information.

deployment_points.name: Develop a maintenance schedule for all equipment to ensure regular checks and servicing are performed.
Assign qualified personnel to carry out maintenance tasks and document their qualifications.
Maintain records of all maintenance activities, including dates, actions taken, and any issues identified.
Implement a monitoring system to track equipment performance and identify potential maintenance needs proactively.
Review and update maintenance procedures regularly to incorporate new technologies and best practices.

controls.name: secure disposal or re-use of equipment
equipment shall be sited securely and protected
controls.description: Define and document processes and requirements to address the control: Equipment shall be sited securely and protected. Assign appropriate responsibilities and implement the required measures for equipment siting and protection. Establish and maintain records or evidence demonstrating compliance with equipment siting and protection. Regularly review and monitor the implementation of equipment siting and protection and address identified gaps. Provide appropriate awareness, guidance, or training to relevant personnel for equipment siting and protection.

deployment_points.name: Identify and designate secure locations for all equipment, ensuring they are protected from unauthorized access.
Document the siting requirements and responsibilities for personnel involved in equipment protection.
Implement physical security measures such as locks, access controls, and surveillance systems around equipment locations.
Regularly review and update the siting and protection measures based on risk assessments and incident reports.
Provide training and awareness programs for staff on the importance of equipment siting and protection.

controls.description: Items of equipment containing storage media shall be verified to ensure that any sensitive data and licensed software has been removed or securely overwritten prior to disposal or re-use.

deployment_points.name: Establish a secure process for the disposal or re-use of equipment that includes data sanitization procedures.
Verify that all storage media is wiped or destroyed using industry-standard methods before disposal.
Document the disposal process, including serial numbers of equipment and methods used for data destruction.
Train personnel involved in the disposal process on secure data handling and disposal techniques.
Conduct regular audits of disposed equipment to ensure compliance with the established procedures.

controls.name: off-site assets shall be protected
controls.description: Define and document processes and requirements to address the control: Off-site assets shall be protected. Assign appropriate responsibilities and implement the required measures for security of assets off-premises. Establish and maintain records or evidence demonstrating compliance with security of assets off-premises. Regularly review and monitor the implementation of security of assets off-premises and address identified gaps. Provide appropriate awareness, guidance, or training to relevant personnel for security of assets off-premises.

deployment_points.name: Develop a policy for the protection of off-site assets, including guidelines for secure transport and storage.
Assign responsibilities to personnel for monitoring and managing off-site assets.
Implement security measures such as encryption, tracking, and access controls for off-site assets.
Maintain records of all off-site assets, including their locations and security measures in place.
Conduct regular reviews and audits of off-site asset security to identify and address vulnerabilities.

controls.name: user end point devices
controls.description: Information stored on, processed by or accessible via user end point devices shall be protected.

deployment_points.name: Implement encryption on all user end point devices to protect data at rest and in transit.
Establish and enforce strong password policies for user accounts on these devices.
Regularly update and patch operating systems and applications to mitigate vulnerabilities.
Deploy endpoint protection solutions, such as antivirus and anti-malware software, to detect and respond to threats.
Conduct user training and awareness programs to educate users about safe practices and potential risks.

controls.name: privileged access rights
controls.description: The allocation and use of privileged access rights shall be restricted and managed.

deployment_points.name: Define and document a clear policy for granting and revoking privileged access rights.
Implement a role-based access control (RBAC) system to manage user permissions effectively.
Regularly review and audit privileged access rights to ensure compliance with the policy.
Use multi-factor authentication (MFA) for all accounts with privileged access to enhance security.
Train staff on the importance of safeguarding privileged credentials and recognizing potential threats.

controls.name: information access restriction
controls.description: Access to information and other associated assets shall be restricted in accordance with the established topic-specific policy on access control.

deployment_points.name: Develop and document a comprehensive access control policy that outlines user roles and permissions.
Implement access control mechanisms, such as ACLs (Access Control Lists) and RBAC, to enforce restrictions.
Regularly review and update access permissions based on changes in user roles or organizational structure.
Monitor access logs to detect unauthorized access attempts and respond accordingly.
Provide training to employees on the importance of adhering to access control policies and procedures.

controls.name: access to source code
controls.description: Read and write access to source code, development tools and software libraries shall be appropriately managed.

deployment_points.name: Implement version control systems to manage access to source code and track changes.
Define user roles and permissions for accessing source code and development tools.
Regularly audit access logs to ensure compliance with access policies and detect anomalies.
Use secure coding practices and conduct code reviews to identify vulnerabilities.
Provide training for developers on secure coding standards and the importance of protecting source code.

controls.name: secure authentication
controls.description: Secure authentication technologies and procedures shall be implemented based on information access restrictions and the topic-specific policy on access control.

deployment_points.name: Implement multi-factor authentication (MFA) for all user accounts to enhance security.
Establish strong password policies that require complex passwords and regular changes.
Use secure protocols (e.g., HTTPS, SSH) for transmitting authentication credentials.
Regularly review and update authentication methods to incorporate new technologies and best practices.
Train users on secure authentication practices and the importance of protecting their credentials.

controls.name: capacity management
controls.description: The use of resources shall be monitored and adjusted in line with current and expected capacity requirements.

deployment_points.name: Implement monitoring tools to track resource usage and performance metrics in real-time.
Establish thresholds for resource utilization that trigger alerts for potential capacity issues.
Regularly review capacity reports to identify trends and forecast future resource needs.
Develop a capacity planning process that includes scaling resources based on demand.
Train IT staff on capacity management best practices and the importance of proactive resource allocation.

controls.name: protection against malware
controls.description: Protection against malware shall be implemented and supported by appropriate user awareness.

deployment_points.name: Deploy comprehensive anti-malware solutions on all endpoints and servers to detect and mitigate threats.
Regularly update malware definitions and software to protect against the latest threats.
Conduct user training sessions to raise awareness about phishing attacks and safe browsing practices.
Implement email filtering solutions to block malicious attachments and links.
Establish an incident response plan to address malware infections and minimize impact.

controls.name: management of technical vulnerabilities
controls.description: Information about technical vulnerabilities of information systems in use shall be obtained, the organizationΓÇÖs exposure to such vulnerabilities shall be evaluated and appropriate measures shall be taken.

deployment_points.name: Regularly conduct vulnerability assessments and penetration testing on information systems.
Subscribe to vulnerability databases and threat intelligence feeds to stay informed about new vulnerabilities.
Prioritize vulnerabilities based on risk assessment and potential impact on the organization.
Develop and implement a remediation plan to address identified vulnerabilities in a timely manner.
Train IT staff on vulnerability management processes and the importance of proactive security measures.

controls.name: configuration management
controls.description: Configurations, including security configurations, of hardware, software, services and networks shall be established, documented, implemented, monitored and reviewed.

deployment_points.name: Develop a configuration management policy that outlines standards for hardware and software configurations.
Use configuration management tools to automate the documentation and monitoring of configurations.
Regularly review and audit configurations to ensure compliance with established standards.
Implement change management processes to control modifications to configurations.
Train staff on configuration management best practices and the importance of maintaining secure configurations.

controls.name: information deletion
controls.description: Information stored in information systems, devices or in any other storage media shall be deleted when no longer required.

deployment_points.name: Establish a data retention policy that defines how long different types of information should be kept.
Implement automated deletion processes for data that is no longer required based on the retention policy.
Ensure that deletion methods comply with industry standards for data destruction to prevent recovery.
Regularly review and audit data deletion practices to ensure compliance with the policy.
Train employees on the importance of data deletion and the risks associated with retaining unnecessary information.

controls.name: data masking
controls.description: Data masking shall be used in accordance with the organizationΓÇÖs topic-specific policy on access control and other related topic-specific policies, and business requirements, taking applicable legislation into consideration.

deployment_points.name: Identify sensitive data that requires masking based on the organization's data classification policy.
Implement data masking techniques such as tokenization or encryption to protect sensitive information in non-production environments.
Ensure that the data masking process complies with relevant legislation and organizational policies.
Regularly review and update the data masking methods to adapt to changes in business requirements and technology.
Train staff on the importance of data masking and the specific procedures to follow when handling sensitive information.

controls.name: data leakage prevention
controls.description: Data leakage prevention measures shall be applied to systems, networks and any other devices that process, store or transmit sensitive information.

deployment_points.name: Assess and identify all systems, networks, and devices that handle sensitive information to determine where data leakage prevention is necessary.
Implement data leakage prevention tools that monitor and control data transfers, ensuring sensitive information is not improperly shared or accessed.
Establish policies and procedures for data handling that include guidelines on acceptable use and data sharing practices.
Regularly test and update data leakage prevention measures to address new threats and vulnerabilities.
Provide training for employees on data leakage prevention policies and the importance of safeguarding sensitive information.

controls.name: information backup
controls.description: Backup copies of information, software and systems shall be maintained and regularly tested in accordance with the agreed topic-specific policy on backup.

deployment_points.name: Develop a comprehensive backup policy that outlines the frequency, scope, and methods for backing up information and systems.
Implement automated backup solutions to ensure regular and consistent backups of critical data and systems.
Store backup copies in secure, offsite locations to protect against data loss due to physical disasters.
Regularly test backup restoration processes to ensure data can be recovered quickly and accurately when needed.
Review and update the backup policy periodically to reflect changes in technology and business requirements.

controls.name: redundancy of information processing facilities
controls.description: Information processing facilities shall be implemented with redundancy sufficient to meet availability requirements.

deployment_points.name: Assess the criticality of information processing facilities to determine the level of redundancy required for each facility.
Implement redundant systems, such as backup servers and failover mechanisms, to ensure continuous operation during failures.
Regularly test the redundancy systems to ensure they function correctly and can take over seamlessly in case of a primary system failure.
Document the redundancy architecture and procedures to ensure clarity and understanding among IT staff.
Monitor the performance of redundant systems to identify and address any potential issues proactively.

controls.name: logging
controls.description: Logs that record activities, exceptions, faults and other relevant events shall be produced, stored, protected and analysed.

deployment_points.name: Establish a logging policy that defines what events should be logged, including user activities, system errors, and security incidents.
Implement logging mechanisms across all systems and applications to capture relevant data in real-time.
Ensure that logs are securely stored and protected from unauthorized access or tampering.
Regularly review and analyze logs to identify anomalies or potential security incidents that require further investigation.
Retain logs for a defined period in accordance with legal and regulatory requirements, and ensure they are disposed of securely when no longer needed.

controls.name: monitoring activities
controls.description: Networks, systems and applications shall be monitored for anomalous behaviour and appropriate actions taken to evaluate potential information security incidents.

deployment_points.name: Implement monitoring tools that provide real-time visibility into network traffic, system performance, and application behavior.
Define baseline behavior for systems and networks to identify deviations that may indicate security incidents.
Establish incident response procedures to follow when anomalous behavior is detected, including escalation paths and communication protocols.
Regularly review monitoring configurations and thresholds to ensure they remain effective against evolving threats.
Train staff on the importance of monitoring and the procedures for responding to detected anomalies.

controls.name: clock synchronization
controls.description: The clocks of information processing systems used by the organization shall be synchronized to approved time sources.

deployment_points.name: Identify and configure approved time sources, such as NTP servers, for synchronizing clocks across all information processing systems.
Implement automated synchronization processes to ensure that all systems maintain accurate time settings.
Regularly verify the accuracy of time synchronization and address any discrepancies promptly.
Document the time synchronization procedures and ensure they are communicated to relevant IT staff.
Monitor the synchronization status of systems to ensure compliance and address any failures in real-time.

controls.name: use of privileged utility programs
controls.description: The use of utility programs that can be capable of overriding system and application controls shall be restricted and tightly controlled.

deployment_points.name: Identify all privileged utility programs within the organization and assess their potential risks and benefits.
Establish strict access controls to limit the use of these programs to authorized personnel only.
Implement logging and monitoring of all activities performed using privileged utility programs to detect any unauthorized use.
Regularly review and update the list of authorized users and the necessity of each utility program.
Provide training for authorized personnel on the proper use and risks associated with privileged utility programs.

controls.name: installation of software on operational systems
controls.description: Procedures and measures shall be implemented to securely manage software installation on operational systems.

deployment_points.name: Develop a software installation policy that outlines the approval process, security requirements, and documentation needed for new software.
Implement a centralized software management system to control and monitor software installations across operational systems.
Conduct security assessments of software before installation to identify potential vulnerabilities or risks.
Regularly review installed software to ensure compliance with organizational policies and remove any unauthorized applications.
Train staff on the software installation procedures and the importance of maintaining a secure operational environment.

controls.name: network security
controls.description: Networks and network devices shall be secured, managed and controlled to protect information in systems and applications.

deployment_points.name: Conduct a comprehensive risk assessment of the network to identify vulnerabilities and areas requiring enhanced security measures.
Implement firewalls, intrusion detection systems, and other security technologies to protect network perimeters and internal segments.
Establish access control policies to restrict network access based on user roles and responsibilities.
Regularly update and patch network devices to protect against known vulnerabilities and threats.
Monitor network traffic continuously to detect and respond to suspicious activities or potential security incidents.

controls.name: security of network services
controls.description: Security mechanisms, service levels and service requirements of network services shall be identified, implemented and monitored.

deployment_points.name: Identify all network services in use and document their security requirements and service levels.
Implement security mechanisms such as firewalls, intrusion detection systems, and encryption for data in transit.
Establish monitoring processes to regularly assess the effectiveness of security controls on network services.
Create a schedule for periodic reviews of service levels and security mechanisms to ensure they meet organizational needs.
Train relevant personnel on the security requirements and monitoring processes for network services.

controls.name: segregation of networks
controls.description: Groups of information services, users and information systems shall be segregated in the organizationΓÇÖs networks.

deployment_points.name: Identify and categorize information services, users, and systems that require segregation based on sensitivity and access needs.
Design and implement network segmentation using VLANs or subnets to separate different groups effectively.
Establish access controls to ensure that only authorized users can access specific network segments.
Monitor network traffic between segments to detect unauthorized access attempts or anomalies.
Regularly review and update the segregation policies to adapt to changes in the organizationΓÇÖs structure or technology.

controls.name: web filtering
controls.description: Access to external websites shall be managed to reduce exposure to malicious content.

deployment_points.name: Implement a web filtering solution that categorizes and blocks access to known malicious websites.
Define and document acceptable use policies for internet access that align with organizational security objectives.
Regularly update the filtering rules and categories to adapt to emerging threats and changes in web content.
Monitor and log web access attempts to identify patterns of misuse or potential security incidents.
Provide training to users on safe browsing practices and the importance of web filtering in protecting organizational assets.

controls.name: use of cryptography
controls.description: Rules for the effective use of cryptography, including cryptographic key management, shall be defined and implemented.

deployment_points.name: Develop and document a cryptography policy that outlines the types of data requiring encryption and the methods to be used.
Implement cryptographic solutions for data at rest and in transit, ensuring compliance with industry standards.
Establish a key management process that includes key generation, distribution, storage, rotation, and destruction.
Regularly audit cryptographic implementations to ensure adherence to the defined policies and effectiveness.
Train personnel on cryptographic practices and the importance of secure key management.

controls.name: establish and maintain records for secure development life cycle
controls.description: Establish and maintain records or evidence demonstrating compliance with secure development life cycle.

deployment_points.name: Define the documentation requirements for each phase of the secure development life cycle (SDLC).
Implement a centralized repository for storing all records related to the SDLC, ensuring easy access and version control.
Regularly review and update records to reflect changes in the development process or compliance requirements.
Assign responsibilities for maintaining and auditing SDLC records to ensure accountability.
Train development teams on the importance of documentation and compliance with the SDLC.

controls.name: regularly review secure development life cycle
controls.description: Regularly review and monitor the implementation of secure development life cycle and address identified gaps.

deployment_points.name: Establish a review schedule for the secure development life cycle to ensure regular assessments are conducted.
Create a checklist of key components to evaluate during the review process, including compliance with security requirements.
Document findings from each review and develop action plans to address any identified gaps or weaknesses.
Involve stakeholders from various departments to provide a comprehensive perspective during the review process.
Communicate the results of the reviews and action plans to relevant teams to foster a culture of continuous improvement.

controls.name: provide training for secure development life cycle
controls.description: Provide appropriate awareness, guidance, or training to relevant personnel for secure development life cycle.

deployment_points.name: Develop a training program that covers the principles and practices of the secure development life cycle.
Schedule regular training sessions for all personnel involved in software development and security.
Create training materials that include case studies, best practices, and compliance requirements related to the SDLC.
Assess the effectiveness of training through feedback and knowledge checks to ensure understanding.
Update training content regularly to reflect changes in technology, threats, and organizational policies.

controls.name: application security requirements
controls.description: Information security requirements shall be identified, specified and approved when developing or acquiring applications.

deployment_points.name: Establish a process for identifying and documenting security requirements during the application development lifecycle.
Involve stakeholders from security, development, and business units to ensure comprehensive requirement gathering.
Create a template for specifying security requirements that can be used consistently across projects.
Review and approve security requirements before development begins to ensure alignment with organizational policies.
Monitor compliance with security requirements throughout the development process and during application testing.

controls.name: secure system architecture and engineering principles
controls.description: Principles for engineering secure systems shall be established, documented, maintained and applied to any information system development activities.

deployment_points.name: Develop a set of secure architecture principles that align with organizational security policies and best practices.
Document these principles and ensure they are accessible to all relevant personnel involved in system development.
Integrate secure architecture principles into the system development lifecycle to guide design and implementation.
Conduct regular reviews of system architectures to ensure compliance with established security principles.
Provide training to development teams on secure architecture principles and their application in projects.

controls.name: establish secure coding principles
controls.description: Secure coding principles shall be applied to software development.

deployment_points.name: Develop a set of secure coding standards that align with industry best practices and organizational policies.
Document these standards and ensure they are communicated to all developers and relevant stakeholders.
Integrate secure coding principles into the software development lifecycle, ensuring they are considered at every stage.
Conduct regular code reviews and static analysis to identify and remediate security vulnerabilities.
Provide training and resources to developers on secure coding practices and the importance of security in software development.

controls.name: establish and maintain records for secure coding
controls.description: Establish and maintain records or evidence demonstrating compliance with secure coding.

deployment_points.name: Define a structured format for documenting secure coding practices and compliance records.
Implement a centralized repository for storing all secure coding records, ensuring access control and versioning.
Regularly update the records to reflect changes in secure coding standards and practices.
Assign responsibility to specific personnel for maintaining and reviewing the records periodically.
Conduct audits to verify the completeness and accuracy of the secure coding records.

controls.name: regularly review secure coding
controls.description: Regularly review and monitor the implementation of secure coding and address identified gaps.

deployment_points.name: Establish a schedule for regular reviews of secure coding practices, ideally quarterly.
Create a checklist of secure coding standards to evaluate during the review process.
Document findings from each review, including identified gaps and recommended actions.
Assign a team to address the identified gaps and track the implementation of corrective actions.
Report the outcomes of the reviews to management to ensure accountability and continuous improvement.

controls.name: provide training for secure coding
controls.description: Provide appropriate awareness, guidance, or training to relevant personnel for secure coding.

deployment_points.name: Develop a comprehensive training program focused on secure coding principles and practices.
Schedule regular training sessions for all relevant personnel, including developers and QA teams.
Utilize a mix of training methods, such as workshops, online courses, and hands-on coding exercises.
Assess the effectiveness of the training through quizzes or practical assessments post-training.
Maintain records of training attendance and feedback for continuous improvement of the training program.

controls.name: security testing in development and acceptance
controls.description: Security testing processes shall be defined and implemented in the development and acceptance life cycle.

deployment_points.name: Define a security testing framework that outlines the types of tests to be conducted during development and acceptance.
Integrate security testing tools into the development pipeline to automate vulnerability scanning.
Establish criteria for passing security tests that must be met before moving to the acceptance phase.
Document all security testing results and remediation actions taken for transparency and accountability.
Review and update the security testing processes regularly to adapt to new threats and vulnerabilities.

controls.name: outsourced development
controls.description: The organization shall direct, monitor and review the activities related to outsourced system development.

deployment_points.name: Establish clear guidelines and expectations for outsourced development projects, including security requirements.
Monitor the progress of outsourced projects through regular status meetings and progress reports.
Conduct periodic reviews of the outsourced development work to ensure compliance with organizational standards.
Implement a feedback mechanism to address any issues or concerns raised during the outsourcing process.
Maintain documentation of all outsourced activities, including contracts, deliverables, and performance evaluations.

controls.name: establish separation of environments
controls.description: Development, testing and production environments shall be separated and secured.

deployment_points.name: Define distinct environments for development, testing, and production to prevent cross-contamination.
Implement access controls to restrict personnel from accessing production environments during development and testing.
Use virtualization or containerization technologies to create isolated environments for each phase.
Regularly review and audit the separation of environments to ensure compliance with established policies.
Document the configuration and security measures in place for each environment to maintain clarity and accountability.

controls.name: establish and maintain records for environments
controls.description: Establish and maintain records or evidence demonstrating compliance with development, testing and production environments.

deployment_points.name: Create a standardized template for documenting the configuration and security measures of each environment.
Store all records in a secure, centralized repository with controlled access to ensure integrity.
Regularly update the records to reflect any changes in environment configurations or security policies.
Assign responsibility for maintaining these records to specific personnel to ensure accountability.
Conduct periodic audits of the records to verify their accuracy and completeness.

controls.name: regularly review environments
controls.description: Regularly review and monitor the implementation of development, testing and production environments and address identified gaps.

deployment_points.name: Schedule regular reviews of all environments to assess compliance with security policies and standards.
Develop a checklist of criteria to evaluate the security and functionality of each environment.
Document any gaps identified during the reviews and prioritize them for remediation.
Assign teams to address the identified gaps and track their progress until resolution.
Report the findings of the reviews to management to ensure visibility and support for necessary changes.

controls.name: provide training for environments
controls.description: Provide appropriate awareness, guidance, or training to relevant personnel for development, testing and production environments.

deployment_points.name: Develop a training curriculum that covers the importance of environment separation and security practices.
Schedule training sessions for all personnel involved in development, testing, and production activities.
Use a variety of training methods, including presentations, hands-on workshops, and e-learning modules.
Evaluate the effectiveness of the training through assessments and feedback from participants.
Maintain records of training completion and participant feedback for continuous improvement.

controls.name: change management
controls.description: Changes to information processing facilities and information systems shall be subject to change management procedures.

deployment_points.name: Establish a formal change management process that includes request, review, approval, and implementation stages.
Document all change requests in a centralized system to track their status and history.
Assign a change advisory board to review and approve significant changes before implementation.
Conduct impact assessments for each change to evaluate potential risks and effects on existing systems.
Review and update change management procedures regularly to ensure they remain effective and relevant.

controls.name: establish management of test information
controls.description: Test information shall be appropriately selected, protected and managed.

deployment_points.name: Identify the types of test information that need to be managed, including data sources and formats.
Develop a policy outlining the selection criteria for test information, ensuring it aligns with organizational goals.
Implement access controls to protect test information from unauthorized access or modification.
Establish a process for regularly updating and reviewing the management practices for test information.
Train relevant personnel on the importance of managing test information and the procedures in place.

controls.name: establish and maintain records for test information
controls.description: Establish and maintain records or evidence demonstrating compliance with test information.

deployment_points.name: Create a standardized template for recording test information that includes all necessary fields for compliance.
Implement a centralized repository for storing records of test information, ensuring it is secure and accessible.
Define retention policies for how long records should be kept and the process for their disposal.
Regularly audit the records to ensure they are complete, accurate, and up-to-date.
Provide training to staff on how to properly document and maintain records related to test information.

controls.name: regularly review test information
controls.description: Regularly review and monitor the implementation of test information and address identified gaps.

deployment_points.name: Schedule periodic reviews of test information management practices to assess their effectiveness.
Develop a checklist of criteria to evaluate the implementation of test information controls.
Assign responsibility to specific personnel for conducting the reviews and reporting findings.
Create a process for addressing any gaps identified during the review, including corrective actions.
Document the outcomes of each review and communicate findings to relevant stakeholders.

controls.name: provide training for test information
controls.description: Provide appropriate awareness, guidance, or training to relevant personnel for test information.

deployment_points.name: Develop a training program that covers the importance of test information management and compliance requirements.
Schedule regular training sessions for all relevant personnel, ensuring participation is tracked.
Create training materials, such as presentations and handouts, that can be easily accessed by staff.
Evaluate the effectiveness of the training through assessments or feedback from participants.
Update training content regularly to reflect changes in policies or procedures related to test information.

controls.name: protection of information systems during audit
controls.description: Audit tests and other assurance activities involving assessment of operational systems shall be planned and agreed between the tester and appropriate management.

deployment_points.name: Develop a formal audit plan that outlines the scope, objectives, and methodology for the audit.
Schedule meetings between auditors and management to discuss and agree on the audit plan and expectations.
Ensure that all necessary resources, including personnel and tools, are allocated for the audit process.
Implement security measures to protect information systems during the audit, including access controls and monitoring.
Document the audit process and findings, and ensure that results are communicated to management for review.

assigned_framework_deployment_points.point: Develop an internal audit schedule that outlines the frequency and scope of audits based on the importance of processes and previous audit results.

deployment_gap_results.assigned_framework_control_description: The organization shall conduct internal audits at planned intervals to determine whether the quality management system a) conforms to the planned arrangements (see7.1), to the requirements of this International Standard and to the quality management system requirements established by the organization, and b) is effectively implemented and maintained. An audit programme shall be planned, taking into consideration the status and importance of the processes and areas to be audited, as well as the results of previous audits. The audit criteria, scope, frequency and methods shall be defined. The selection of auditors and conduct of audits shall ensure objectivity and impartiality of the audit process. Auditors shall not audit their own work. A documented procedure shall be established to define the responsibilities and requirements for planning and conducting audits, establishing records and reporting results. Records of the audits and their results shall be maintained (see4.2.4). The management responsible for the area being audited shall ensure that any necessary corrections and corrective actions are taken without undue delay to eliminate detected nonconformities and their causes. Follow-up activities shall include the verification of the actions taken and the reporting of verification results (see8.5.2).
